title: Police identify Fort Mac shooting victim
article: The man killed in a shootout with RCMP in a Fort McMurray, Alta. apartment has been identified.
Abdallah Ahmad, 24, was killed when police responded to a gun call early Wednesday morning last week.
A female officer was shot in the abdomen during the exchange which began as police entered the building. She was taken to hospital in stable condition.
The Alberta Serious Incident Response Team is investigating the shooting.
